_meta.description: Heart event #4 for npc_janis: The Letter

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [Janis holds a crumpled letter. Her hands are shaking slightly]

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: My mother wrote. She called my posting here a 'career death.'

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: She said the Beaumont name deserves better than a backwater town.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: She's right, of course. By every metric I was raised to value.

options.text: She doesn't know what Coppervale really is.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: What do I value? Status. Achievement. Recognition. That's what I was MADE for.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: But lately... I value Pip's drawings. And Linden's optimism.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: And your machines. And this stupid, wonderful, stubborn town.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: Don't tell my mother I said that.
